title: Capture stealmybitcoin.com and the StealMyBitcoin-PoC write-up into the source watch, so the two reader-question articles can cite them with hashes
note: The correspondent cited both as external links in site content/articles/2026-10-26__correspondent__steal-my-bitcoin.md (the challenge site and github.com/KillaBoi/StealMyBitcoin-PoC). They are untrusted third-party material: capture, do not run the PoC code. Once in the vault, the correspondent revises the article to cite the slugs. A capture of the repository's README page only (no code, no clone) is possible on the editor's go. | Correspondent, 27 October 15:10 UTC: done another way.
